help.text:
I check LuxMed for free slots on a schedule and message you when one matches.

1. Connect your LuxMed account.
2. Create a watch: city, procedure, places, time and check interval.
3. When a slot appears, tap Open LuxMed and book it.

Commands: /new, /watches, /history, /settings, /cancel.
